jpGuide1: クズ鉄の大穴へ。クズ鉄の大穴に行くには、マップ上の鉄道高架下をくぐる。最深部にあるスイッチをONにしてガスを止めるとクリア。
jpGuide2: G#24　クズ鉄の大穴の恐怖のガス
enGuide: Reach Scrap-Iron Pit by passing under the railway overpass on the world map. Go to the deepest area and switch the gas control ON; then settle the completed job at the guild so the follow-up can appear.

jpGuide1: クズ鉄の大穴へ。ガススイッチのさらに奥へ行き、最深部にある動く柱をすべて押して一番奥のモンスター出現口を塞ぐ。
jpGuide2: G#25　モンスターがあふれでてくる！？
enGuide: After settling G#24, leave the guild so this job appears. Return to the Scrap-Iron Pit, go beyond the gas switch, and push every movable pillar to seal the monster-spawn opening at the back. Stepping on patterned floor tiles spawns monsters; the success message confirms the opening is sealed.

jpGuide1: 再生品協会へ行った後にクズ鉄置き場で戦闘。5ターンの間、モンスターをボビーに近づけなければ成功。
jpGuide2: G#26　鉄クズ置き場のクズ鉄拾いの警護
enGuide: Visit the Recycled Goods Association first, then go to the Scrap Yard. During the battle, keep monsters away from Bobby for five turns; surviving the protection period clears the job.

simpleJp: SA-200SPの手配書を念のため確認する
jpGuide1: 手配モンスターSA-200SPなどと戦闘。
enGuide: Conservative prep only: Set B is internally inconsistent about whether the poster is required for the reward, so checking it is harmless but not treated as a verified prerequisite.
